races.paceDynamic: The Liffey and Dontspoilasale will lead the field early with Thaloria and Suerte also showing pace from prominent positions, creating a moderate gallop over the 7f trip. The strong hold-up contingent of Benavente, Una Matata, Ruff Justice and Crest Of Light will sit back and rely on the sustained pace to set up their finishing kicks. This creates a classic scenario where the early pace will be honest but not suicidal, likely favoring those who can finish strongly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained pace favors closers
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners maintain honest gallop without killing pace
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup as The Liffey and Dontspoilasale establish steady fractions. Benavente and Una Matata unleash powerful finishing kicks to sweep past the early leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runners steal march
scenarios.trigger: If The Liffey and Dontspoilasale establish controlling lead without pressure
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too steady allowing the leaders to dictate terms throughout. The Liffey's superior rating tells as the closers find too much to do in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If prominent runners go too slow creating sprint finish
scenarios.body: The early gallop becomes pedestrian as no horse wants to commit. This turns into a 2f dash where Thaloria's prominent position and Una Matata's turn of foot become decisive advantages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace war develops
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners engage in early battle
scenarios.body: The Liffey, Dontspoilasale, Thaloria and Suerte all press forward creating unsustainable fractions. The moderate-rated hold-up horses benefit as the pace setters tie up, allowing Ruff Justice and Crest Of Light to pick up the pieces.

watchPoints.text: Thaloria fading in the final furlong despite traveling well, confirming finishing limitations
The Liffey being allowed uncontested lead as superior rating makes them very dangerous
Una Matata's position turning into straight as hold-up style needs room to maneuver
Early pace development between The Liffey and Dontspoilasale setting up race dynamics
Benavente getting blocked for run as hold-up style requires clear passage in finish

races.paceDynamic: Spinning Around is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate a steady tempo without early pressure from Bishopton, Musical Act, and Venetian who prefer prominent positions just behind. The large contingent of hold-up horses (Blue Anthem, Um Wadi, Nikki Swango, Whistling Jamesie) creates a dangerous wall of closers who need the pace to collapse, setting up a scenario where the early pace will be crucial to the outcome.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Spinning Around Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Spinning Around gets uncontested fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The leader builds a decisive advantage while the hold-up brigade struggles to peg back the deficit. Bishopton and Musical Act battle for minor honors as the closers arrive too late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Cooker
scenarios.trigger: If Bishopton, Musical Act and Venetian all press Spinning Around early
scenarios.body: The pace quickens significantly and the leaders tire, allowing the strongest closer to sweep up. Nikki Swango's proven 7f form makes her the prime beneficiary of the collapse.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Jam
scenarios.trigger: If the closers get bunched up and struggle for racing room in the straight
scenarios.body: Those who can secure a clear passage thrive while others are left with too much to do. Blue Anthem's tactical speed gives him the edge over his fellow hold-up runners.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Surge Triumph
scenarios.trigger: If Um Wadi or Whistling Jamesie overcome their recent finishing concerns and time their run perfectly
scenarios.body: Despite their tendency to fade, one of them produces a career-best finish when everything falls right. The winner catches a tiring field that went too hard early.

watchPoints.text: Spinning Around getting too easy a lead early - if uncontested through halfway could be gone
Traffic problems for the hold-up horses Nikki Swango and Blue Anthem in the home straight
How quickly Bishopton and Musical Act commit to challenging the leader - will determine pace pressure
Um Wadi and Whistling Jamesie both showing signs of not finishing races off strongly

races.paceDynamic: Son Of Wind will set the pace alone from the front with minimal pressure, as the field lacks genuine pace-pressers beyond Jazzy Dancer and Comfort Line who prefer to race prominently rather than chase. This creates a sustainable gallop that heavily favours the 11 hold-up horses who can use their finishing kicks. The lack of early speed will result in a bunched field turning for home with the race decided by who handles the ground best and times their run perfectly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Son Of Wind Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Wind dictates fractions without pressure and stays strong
scenarios.body: The leader gets an easy time of it and kicks clear when the field finally comes after him. Hold-up horses leave their runs too late having given him too much rope.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely slow and multiple closers get into contention
scenarios.body: The bunch finish heavily favours horses with the strongest finishing kicks who haven't been compromised by fade-in-finish tendencies. Winemaker and Roman Harry time their challenges perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Jazzy Dancer and Comfort Line press forward and soften up Son Of Wind
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes more honest, suiting horses who can stay close to the action without being right on the speed. Jazzy Dancer's proven course form tells.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Wind stops quickly and no horse can organise a sustained challenge
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint where any horse getting a clear run can grab it. Lesser lights with no finishing concerns benefit from the chaos.

The large contingent of hold-up horses (Mephisto, Slowdownbarney, Desert Friend, Disco Boy, Black Soul, Deluca Chop, Sarmiento Power) will create a cavalry charge finish if the pace stays honest.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Setup
scenarios.trigger: If Jazz Forever leads uncontested with the prominent trio tracking at sensible fractions
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop will suit the patient hold-up brigade who can time their challenges late. Mephisto and Slowdownbarney will be perfectly positioned for strong finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Numidia, Hobart and Circus Act engage Jazz Forever early creating genuine pace pressure

scenarios.body: The change of pace dynamics will disrupt the hold-up horses' timing and favor those racing closer. Circus Act's stamina-laden pedigree suits taking advantage of the revised tempo.
